Job Description 
 This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the successful candidate is expected to report to Warren Global Technical Center three times per week, at minimum [or other frequency dictated by the business if more than 3 days]. 

 The Role 

 We are seeking a Full Stack Robotics Data Engineer / Data Scientist to join our manufacturing data organization. In this role, you will contribute to the data and data science foundation that enables robotics intelligence across manufacturing environments. You will work across data engineering, applied data science, and production software to transform robotics data into trusted datasets, analytics, and applications that support model development, operational insights, and continuous improvement.

 This is an individual contributor role for someone who can develop reliable solutions across data pipelines, cloud and application development, analytics, and problem solving. You will work with robotics engineers, manufacturing stakeholders, software developers, data engineers, and data scientists to deliver end-to-end solutions that are useful, maintainable, and aligned with business needs.

 What You’ll Do 
 Develop and maintain data and data science solutions for robotics data ingestion, processing, storage, analysis, visualization, and application access.
 Build and improve data pipelines for robotics and manufacturing data, including sensor streams, telemetry, images, time series, metadata, and operational data.
 Work with robotics, manufacturing, business, and data science stakeholders to understand requirements, investigate data issues, and support evolving infrastructure needs.
 Create analytic datasets and data delivery mechanisms for business intelligence, analytics, model development, monitoring, and decision support.
 Apply statistical analysis, machine learning, and data science methods to identify patterns, diagnose issues, and support improvements in system performance.
 Help translate robotics behavior, anomalies, and failure modes into curated datasets, actionable insights, and measurable improvement opportunities.
 Support reproducible analytics and model development through data versioning, lineage, traceability, experiment tracking, and MLOps practices.
 Develop and maintain internal tools, APIs, metadata, logical data models, and data standards that improve usability, governance, scalability, and reliability.
 Contribute to automation, documentation, testing, data quality, and infrastructure improvements.
 Participate in code reviews, production support, and cross-functional technical discussions.
 


 Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications) 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Robotics, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.
 5+ year of professional experience in data engineering, software engineering, machine learning engineering, applied data science, or a closely related role (or 3+ years with advanced degrees).
 Proficiency in Python and familiarity with at least one additional programming language, such as Java, C++, or Scala.
 Experience developing data pipelines, backend services, APIs, or full-stack data applications.
 Familiarity with cloud platforms, data orchestration frameworks, and data modeling for analytics, business intelligence, or machine learning use cases.
 Experience working with data processing, streaming, or distributed systems technologies such as Spark, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Cassandra, or similar platforms.
 Experience applying data science or machine learning techniques to engineering, manufacturing, or operational problems.
 Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including version control, testing, CI/CD, documentation, automation, and production support.
 Strong problem-solving, organizational, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
 Ability to learn new technologies and work effectively in a dynamic, interdisciplinary environment.
 
 What Can Give You a Competitive Advantage (Preferred Qualifications) 
 Advanced degree in Data Science, Robotics, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
 Experience with robotics, autonomous systems, industrial IoT, manufacturing analytics, or other complex physical systems.
 Familiarity with ROS/ROS 2, robotics telemetry, logging, replay, or simulation data workflows.
 Exposure to machine learning lifecycle and data quality tools, including feature engineering, experiment tracking, model registry, deployment automation, or active learning workflows.
 Familiarity with data governance, lineage, auditability, and reproducibility practices.
 Experience contributing to technical standards, improving development practices, or supporting the growth of teammates.
  
 This job may be eligible for relocation benefits.

 Compensation:  
 The expected base compensation for this role is: $104,500 - $132,350. Actual base compensation within the identified range will vary based on factors relevant to the position. 
 Bonus Potential: An incentive pay program offers payouts based on company performance, job level, and individual performance. 
 Benefits: GM offers a variety of health and wellbeing benefit programs. Benefit options include medical, dental, vision, Health Savings Account, Flexible Spending Accounts, retirement savings plan, sickness and accident benefits, life insurance, paid vacation & holidays, tuition assistance programs, employee assistance program, GM vehicle discounts and more. 
 
 GM DOES NOT PROVIDE IMMIGRATION-RELATED SPONSORSHIP FOR THIS ROLE. DO NOT APPLY FOR THIS ROLE IF YOU WILL NEED GM IMMIGRATION SPONSORSHIP NOW OR IN THE FUTURE. THIS INCLUDES DIRECT COMPANY SPONSORSHIP, ENTRY OF GM AS THE IMMIGRATION EMPLOYER OF RECORD ON A GOVERNMENT FORM, AND ANY WORK AUTHORIZATION REQUIRING A WRITTEN SUBMISSION OR OTHER IMMIGRATION SUPPORT FROM THE COMPANY (e.g., H-1B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc.)
